questions.answer: The swiss are similar to the danes.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Notice that exams for spring the semester are in august.
Do not be afraid of the academic level. It is the same as UCPH.
If you are offered a room at Meierwiesenstrasse 62, then accept it. The place is somewhat chaotic but very social.
